about: Buildings surveyed in Google Street View (imagery Feb 2026, viewed in the web page on 2026-11-21; nothing copied into the model). Each entry overrides the facade, and where given the height, of the Overture footprint whose centroid is nearest (x, y) in scene metres (origin 72.867 E, 19.111 N). Heights marked 'sv' are storeys counted in Street View x storey height; others keep the satellite estimate. 'ground': 'signs' gives the ground and first floor the signboard band. The satellite surface model reads 3-5 times too tall for these low frontage blocks (trees and taller buildings behind blur into them), so every height here is the Street View storey count.

stations.Marol Naka (Line 1): Street View 19.10812,72.88040 heading 268 and 19.10815,72.87960 heading 90: concourse slab spans the whole road on large grey round piers and blue-painted square columns; the concourse is clad opaque with a billboard band (no full glazing); platform level under a flat grey metal canopy with a deep fascia on blue steel columns; a white-and-blue lift and stair core; covered stairs to the footpath with blue railings and blue roofs; shops and a bank under the deck.
